request: I run a small tailoring shop in Kumasi and I want to keep my orders in order. I need to save each customer with their name, phone number and their measurements: chest, waist, hip and length, all in inches. For a customer I take orders, and each order has the garment, the date it is due, the price and the deposit the customer has paid, in cedis. The deposit can never be more than the price. I want to see all the orders for one customer and look at a single order. I also want to see every order that is due on or before a date I choose, so I know what to finish first. When a customer picks up their clothes I mark the order as collected, and collected orders should no longer show in that due list.
summary:
I've built the system for your shop in `app.py`, and all 5 of my tests pass. It saves everything in a file called `tailoring.db` in the same folder.

**What it can do:**

| Action | Address | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Add a customer | `POST /customers` | Saves name, phone number, chest, waist, hip and length (in inches). |
| Look up a customer | `GET /customers/{id}` | Shows one customer's details and measurements. |
| Add an order | `POST /customers/{id}/orders` | Saves the garment, due date (written as year-month-day, e.g. 2030-05-10), price and deposit in cedis. New orders start as not collected. |
| A customer's orders | `GET /customers/{id}/orders` | Lists all orders for that customer, earliest due date first. |
| Look at one order | `GET /orders/{id}` | Shows a single order. |
| Due list | `GET /orders/due?on_or_before=2030-05-10` | Shows every order due on or before the date you pick, earliest first. Collected orders don't appear. |
| Mark as collected | `POST /orders/{id}/collect` | Marks the order as picked up, which takes it off the due list. |

**What it refuses (with an error message):**
- A deposit larger than the price. A deposit equal to the price is allowed, for customers who pay in full.
- A negative price or deposit.
- Measurements that are missing, zero or negative.
- A customer or order number that doesn't exist.

**Things to know:**
- There's no list of all customers, so you'll need to note each customer's number (shown when you add them) to find their orders later.
- An order can't be changed or deleted after it's saved, including updating the deposit when a customer pays more. A collected order also can't be un-marked. I can add any of these if you need them.
